description: Hi! I’m Laís Andrade Morales, 18, high school senior & space lover (OBA/OBAFOG medalist). I lead team Star Promises (Sorocaba). Our project is a 3D virtual tour showing Earth environments that mimic Moon/Mars, like the Atacama Desert. Looking for partners for design (Canva), maps (Google Earth), or storytelling.
summary: Star Promises: Earth-to-Mars and Moon Analog Atlas is an interactive 3D Google Earth (KML) expedition connecting extreme terrestrial environments to Moon and Mars exploration sites. Starting from dual Ground Zeros at the Sorocaba Technology Park in Brazil and the Kennedy Space Center in the USA, our crew and five original characters guide users through 11 global and Brazilian planetary analogs. Powered by open NASA satellite datasets (Landsat, MODIS, ASTER, SRTM, ICESat-2, and LRO) and bilingual vertical video guides, the project combines remote sensing, pop-culture storytelling, and space education to support future Artemis and Mars missions.
details: Star Promises: Earth-to-Mars and Moon Analog Atlas is an interactive 3D Google Earth (KML) expedition connecting extreme terrestrial environments to Moon and Mars exploration sites. Starting at Ground Zero in Sorocaba, Brazil, our crew and AI characters guide users through 11 global and Brazilian planetary analogs—including Wadi Rum, Lençóis Maranhenses, McMurdo Dry Valleys, Askja, Araguainha Crater, and Lajedo de Pai Mateus. Powered by open NASA satellite datasets (Landsat, MODIS, ASTER, SRTM, ICESat-2, and LRO) and bilingual vertical video guides, the project combines remote sensing, pop-culture storytelling, and space education to support future Artemis and Mars missions.
